permitTypes.label: Gate or barricade across a fire lane

letter.heading: Notice of Violation
letter.intro: An inspection of the property named below found the conditions listed on this notice, which do not comply with the fire code adopted by this jurisdiction. Each one must be corrected by the date shown beside it. A re-inspection will be made after that date.
letter.closing: If you have questions about this notice, or need more time to make a correction, call the office below before the date shown. Failure to correct these conditions may result in a citation.

2018.title: Address numbers missing or not readable
2018.description: Address numbers can be read from the street: at least 4 in tall, ½ in stroke, contrasting colour
2018.correctiveAction: Put up address numbers at least 4 inches tall that can be read from the street.

2018.title: Fire lane blocked
2018.description: Fire lane clear: no parked cars, dumpsters or storage
2018.correctiveAction: Move everything parked or stored in the fire lane, and keep it clear at all times.

2018.title: Fire lane markings missing or faded
2018.description: Fire lane signs or red curb marked "No Parking – Fire Lane" and readable
2018.correctiveAction: Mark the fire lane with signs or painted curbs as the fire marshal approves.

2018.title: Fire lane too narrow or overhead clearance blocked
2018.description: Fire lane at least 20 ft wide with 13 ft 6 in clear overhead (trees trimmed)
2018.correctiveAction: Trim trees and remove anything that narrows the lane below 20 ft or lowers the clearance below 13 ft 6 in.

2018.title: Gate across the fire lane doesn't open for the fire department
2018.description: Security gate approved, and it opens for the fire department (Knox switch or strobe works)
2018.correctiveAction: Repair the gate's emergency opening device and have it tested.

2018.title: Key box missing
2018.description: Key box (Knox box) installed where required, in the approved spot
2018.correctiveAction: Install an approved key box where the fire marshal directs.

2018.title: Key box keys out of date
2018.description: Keys in the key box are current
2018.correctiveAction: Call the fire department to meet you and replace the keys in the key box.

2018.title: Fire hydrant blocked
2018.description: Fire hydrant visible, with 3 ft clear all around it
2018.correctiveAction: Clear everything within 3 feet of the fire hydrant.

2018.title: Private hydrants not tested
2018.description: Private hydrants and fire mains inspected and tested this year (NFPA 25)
2018.correctiveAction: Have a licensed company inspect and test the private hydrants and send the report.

2018.title: Fire department connection blocked
2018.description: Fire department connection reachable: 36 in wide, 36 in deep and 78 in high clear in front
2018.correctiveAction: Clear the space in front of the fire department connection.

2018.title: Fire department connection sign missing
2018.description: Fire department connection signed ("Automatic Sprinklers" or "Standpipe")
2018.correctiveAction: Put a sign at the connection saying what it supplies.

2018.title: Fire department connection damaged or uncapped
2018.description: Fire department connection caps in place, swivels turn, nothing inside
2018.correctiveAction: Replace missing caps and have the connection serviced.

2018.title: Equipment room doors not labelled
2018.description: Doors to the sprinkler riser, alarm panel and electrical rooms labelled
2018.correctiveAction: Label the doors to rooms holding fire protection or utility controls.

2018.title: Fire protection equipment blocked
2018.description: Fire protection equipment (riser, alarm panel, valves) reachable, nothing stored in front
2018.correctiveAction: Move the storage away from the fire protection equipment.

2018.title: Exit or exit path blocked
2018.description: Exits, the paths to them and the way out to the street clear and usable while open
2018.correctiveAction: Clear the exit path now, and keep it clear whenever the building is occupied.

2018.title: Corridor, aisle or stairway obstructed
2018.description: Corridors, aisles and stairs free of anything in the way
2018.correctiveAction: Remove what is blocking the corridor, aisle or stairway.

2018.title: Storage in an exit or stairway
2018.description: Nothing that burns stored in exits or stairways
2018.correctiveAction: Remove all storage from exits and stairways.

2018.title: Exit door needs a key or special effort to open
2018.description: Exit doors open from the inside without a key, tool or special effort
2018.correctiveAction: Change the lock so the door opens from inside without a key or special knowledge.

2018.title: Exit door chained, padlocked or barred
2018.description: No chains, padlocks, slide bolts or bars on exit doors while the building is occupied
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the chain, padlock, bolt or bar from the exit door now.

2018.title: Panic hardware missing or broken
2018.description: Panic hardware where required (assembly and schools with 50 or more people), and it works
2018.correctiveAction: Install or repair panic hardware on the exit doors.

2018.title: Exit door swings the wrong way
2018.description: Exit doors swing outward where 50 or more people use them
2018.correctiveAction: Re-hang the door to swing in the direction people leave.

2018.title: Exit sign missing
2018.description: Exit signs at every exit and wherever the way out isn't obvious
2018.correctiveAction: Install exit signs where required.

2018.title: Exit sign not lit
2018.description: Exit signs lit, and they stay lit on battery
2018.correctiveAction: Repair or replace the exit sign or its battery.

2018.title: Emergency lighting not working
2018.description: Emergency lights come on when tested
2018.correctiveAction: Repair or replace the emergency lights or their batteries.

2018.title: Emergency lighting tests not recorded
2018.description: Emergency lights tested monthly (30 sec) and yearly (90 min), with records
2018.correctiveAction: Test the emergency lights monthly and yearly, and keep a written record.

2018.title: Occupant load sign not posted
2018.description: Occupant load sign posted (assembly rooms)
2018.correctiveAction: Post the approved occupant load sign near the main exit.

2018.title: Room overcrowded
2018.description: No more people inside than the posted occupant load
2018.correctiveAction: Reduce the number of people to the posted occupant load now.

2018.title: Exit door hidden or decorated
2018.description: No mirrors, hangings or decorations on or hiding exit doors
2018.correctiveAction: Remove mirrors, curtains or decorations that hide the exit door.

2018.title: Stairway signs missing
2018.description: Stairway floor-number signs in place
2018.correctiveAction: Put up the stairway identification signs on each floor.

2018.title: Escape window blocked or barred
2018.description: Bedroom escape windows open, and any security bars release from inside
2018.correctiveAction: Make the window open fully, or fit bars that release from inside without a key.

2018.title: Fire extinguisher missing
2018.description: Fire extinguishers provided where required
2018.correctiveAction: Install a fire extinguisher of the right type where required.

2018.title: Fire extinguisher service out of date
2018.description: Yearly service tag current, from a company licensed by the State Fire Marshal
2018.correctiveAction: Have the extinguisher serviced by a company licensed by the State Fire Marshal's Office.

2018.title: Monthly extinguisher checks not done
2018.description: Monthly checks initialled on the tag or a log
2018.correctiveAction: Check each extinguisher monthly and initial the tag.

2018.title: Not enough fire extinguishers
2018.description: Right type and size, and no more than 75 ft to reach one
2018.correctiveAction: Add extinguishers so none is more than 75 feet away.

2018.title: Fire extinguisher not mounted
2018.description: Mounted on a hanger or bracket, or in a cabinet
2018.correctiveAction: Mount the extinguisher on a hanger or bracket.

2018.title: Fire extinguisher at the wrong height
2018.description: Top no higher than 5 ft (3½ ft if over 40 lb), bottom at least 4 in off the floor
2018.correctiveAction: Re-hang the extinguisher at the right height.

2018.title: Fire extinguisher hidden or blocked
2018.description: Visible and unobstructed on the normal way through (signed if out of sight)
2018.correctiveAction: Move what's blocking the extinguisher, or put up a sign showing where it is.

2018.title: Kitchen (Class K) extinguisher missing
2018.description: Class K extinguisher near commercial fryers and cooking
2018.correctiveAction: Install a Class K extinguisher within 30 feet of the cooking appliances.

2018.title: Fire extinguisher discharged or damaged
2018.description: Gauge in the green, pin and seal in place, no damage
2018.correctiveAction: Have the extinguisher recharged or replaced.

2018.title: Extinguisher hydrostatic test out of date
2018.description: Hydrostatic test and 6-year internal exam current
2018.correctiveAction: Have the extinguisher tested or replaced.

2018.title: Fire alarm panel in trouble
2018.description: Alarm panel normal: no trouble, supervisory or alarm lights
2018.correctiveAction: Have a licensed alarm company find and fix the trouble condition.

2018.title: Fire alarm not tested this year
2018.description: Yearly fire alarm inspection and test report on file
2018.correctiveAction: Have a licensed alarm company inspect and test the system and send the report.

2018.title: Fire alarm not monitored
2018.description: Alarm monitoring active
2018.correctiveAction: Restore monitoring by an approved central station and tell the fire department.

2018.title: Fire alarm device covered or damaged
2018.description: Pull stations, detectors and horn/strobes uncovered, undamaged and unobstructed
2018.correctiveAction: Uncover, clear or repair the fire alarm devices.

2018.title: Smoke alarm missing or not working
2018.description: Smoke alarms in bedrooms and hallways work and are less than 10 years old
2018.correctiveAction: Install working smoke alarms in every bedroom and the hallway outside.

2018.title: Carbon monoxide alarm missing
2018.description: Carbon monoxide alarms where there are fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage
2018.correctiveAction: Install carbon monoxide alarms where required.

2018.title: Sprinkler control valve closed or unsecured
2018.description: Sprinkler system in service; control valves open and locked, sealed or supervised
2018.correctiveAction: Open and secure the valve and tell the fire department; keep a fire watch until it's restored.

2018.title: Sprinkler system not inspected this year
2018.description: Yearly sprinkler inspection and test report on file
2018.correctiveAction: Have a licensed sprinkler company inspect and test the system and send the report.

2018.title: Sprinkler gauges out of date or reading low
2018.description: Gauges show normal pressure and are less than 5 years old
2018.correctiveAction: Have the gauges replaced or calibrated and the pressure checked.

2018.title: Sprinkler heads damaged, painted or loaded
2018.description: Sprinkler heads not painted, corroded, loaded with dust or grease, or damaged
2018.correctiveAction: Have the affected sprinkler heads replaced by a licensed company.

2018.title: Storage too close to sprinkler heads
2018.description: Storage at least 18 in below sprinkler heads
2018.correctiveAction: Lower the storage so it is at least 18 inches below the sprinkler heads.

2018.title: Spare sprinkler heads missing
2018.description: Spare-head cabinet stocked (at least 6 of each type) with the wrench
2018.correctiveAction: Stock the spare-head cabinet with heads of each type and the wrench.

2018.title: Sprinkler riser room blocked or used for storage
2018.description: Riser room reachable, kept above 40°F, nothing stored in it
2018.correctiveAction: Clear the riser room and keep it heated.

2018.title: Five-year sprinkler pipe inspection not done
2018.description: Five-year internal pipe inspection done
2018.correctiveAction: Have the internal obstruction investigation done and send the report.

2018.title: Fire pump tests not done
2018.description: Fire pump run weekly or monthly and flow-tested yearly, with records
2018.correctiveAction: Run and test the fire pump on schedule and keep the records.

2018.title: Standpipe not maintained
2018.description: Standpipe hose valves capped and reachable; 5-year flow test done
2018.correctiveAction: Cap the hose valves and have the standpipe flow-tested.

2018.title: Backflow preventer not tested
2018.description: Fire line backflow preventer tested this year
2018.correctiveAction: Have the backflow preventer tested by a licensed tester.

2018.title: System out of service without notice or fire watch
2018.description: Any system out of service is tagged, the fire department told, and a fire watch posted
2018.correctiveAction: Tell the fire department and post a fire watch until the system is back in service.

2018.title: Fire protection equipment tampered with
2018.description: No fire protection equipment removed or tampered with
2018.correctiveAction: Restore the equipment and have it checked by a licensed company.

2018.title: Fire protection records not kept
2018.description: Inspection, test and maintenance records kept on site
2018.correctiveAction: Keep the inspection, test and maintenance reports on site.

2018.title: Cooking appliance not protected by the hood system
2018.description: Hood suppression covers every grease-producing appliance
2018.correctiveAction: Move the appliance under the hood, or have the suppression system extended.

2018.title: Hood suppression system not serviced
2018.description: Hood suppression serviced every 6 months (tag or report)
2018.correctiveAction: Have a licensed company service the hood suppression system.

2018.title: Fusible links out of date
2018.description: Fusible links replaced and dated on schedule
2018.correctiveAction: Have the fusible links replaced.

2018.title: Hood system pull station blocked or missing
2018.description: Manual pull station reachable on the way out
2018.correctiveAction: Clear the manual pull station, or have one installed on the way out.

2018.title: Appliances don't shut off with the hood system
2018.description: Fuel or power to the appliances shuts off when the system goes off
2018.correctiveAction: Have the fuel or power shutoff repaired and tested.

2018.title: Hood and duct need cleaning
2018.description: Hood and duct cleaned on schedule (sticker or certificate)
2018.correctiveAction: Have the hood and exhaust duct cleaned by a qualified company and post the certificate.

2018.title: Grease built up on the hood or filters
2018.description: Filters in place; no grease built up on the hood or filters
2018.correctiveAction: Clean the hood and filters and replace any missing filters.

2018.title: Cooking oil stored improperly
2018.description: Cooking oil kept in approved containers or tanks
2018.correctiveAction: Store cooking oil in approved containers or tanks.

2018.title: Extension cord used as permanent wiring
2018.description: Extension cords not used in place of permanent wiring, or run through walls, doors or under rugs
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the extension cords and have permanent outlets installed where needed.

2018.title: Power strips misused
2018.description: Power strips listed, with a breaker, plugged into the wall, not plugged into each other
2018.correctiveAction: Plug each power strip straight into a wall outlet and remove strips plugged into strips.

2018.title: Electrical panel blocked
2018.description: 30 in wide, 36 in deep and 78 in high clear in front of electrical panels
2018.correctiveAction: Clear the space in front of the electrical panel.

2018.title: Exposed wiring or missing cover
2018.description: Covers on junction boxes, outlets, switches and panels; no open splices
2018.correctiveAction: Install covers, and have exposed wiring repaired by a licensed electrician.

2018.title: Temporary wiring in use too long
2018.description: Temporary wiring used no more than 90 days
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the temporary wiring or have permanent wiring installed.

2018.title: Space heater used unsafely
2018.description: Space heaters listed, plugged straight into the wall, 3 ft from anything that burns
2018.correctiveAction: Plug the heater straight into the wall and keep it 3 feet from anything that can burn.

2018.title: Unvented fuel-burning heater in use
2018.description: No unvented fuel-burning portable heaters
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the unvented heater.

2018.title: Fuel-burning appliance installed or vented improperly
2018.description: Fuel-burning appliances installed and vented to code
2018.correctiveAction: Have the appliance installed and vented by a licensed contractor.

2018.title: Combustible waste allowed to build up
2018.description: No piled-up trash or combustible waste
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the trash and combustible waste and keep it from building up.

2018.title: Storage unsafe or too close to heat
2018.description: Storage orderly, stable and away from heaters and lights
2018.correctiveAction: Restack the storage and keep it away from heaters and lights.

2018.title: Storage too close to the ceiling
2018.description: Storage at least 24 in below the ceiling where there are no sprinklers
2018.correctiveAction: Lower the storage to at least 24 inches below the ceiling.

2018.title: Storage in an equipment room
2018.description: Nothing stored in boiler, mechanical, electrical or elevator rooms
2018.correctiveAction: Remove all storage from the equipment room.

2018.title: Storage in a concealed space
2018.description: Nothing stored in attics, under floors or in other hidden spaces
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the storage from the attic or concealed space.

2018.title: Oily rags not in a metal can
2018.description: Oily rags kept in listed metal cans with lids
2018.correctiveAction: Keep oily rags in a listed metal can with a tight lid.

2018.title: Dumpster too close to the building
2018.description: Dumpsters (1½ cubic yards or larger) kept 5 ft from walls, openings and eaves that burn
2018.correctiveAction: Move the dumpster at least 5 feet from the building.

2018.title: Outside storage too close to the building
2018.description: Outside storage kept away from openings, eaves and property lines
2018.correctiveAction: Move the outside storage away from the building and property lines.

2018.title: Vacant building open or unprotected
2018.description: Vacant building secured, and its fire protection kept working
2018.correctiveAction: Secure every opening and keep the fire protection systems working.

2018.title: Grill used too close to the building
2018.description: Grills not on combustible balconies or within 10 ft of combustible construction
2018.correctiveAction: Use grills at least 10 feet from the building and off combustible balconies.

2018.title: No-smoking signs missing
2018.description: "No Smoking" signs where required; approved ash cans provided
2018.correctiveAction: Post no-smoking signs where required.

2018.title: Hot work without a fire watch
2018.description: Hot work has a fire watch during and 30 min after, and an extinguisher within 30 ft
2018.correctiveAction: Stop the hot work until a fire watch and an extinguisher are in place.

2018.title: Fire door propped open or not closing
2018.description: Fire doors close and latch by themselves, and aren't wedged or blocked open
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the wedge or block and repair the closer so the door closes and latches.

2018.title: Fire doors not inspected this year
2018.description: Fire doors inspected and tested this year (NFPA 80 record)
2018.correctiveAction: Have the fire doors inspected and keep the record.

2018.title: Opening in a fire-rated wall or ceiling
2018.description: Holes in fire-rated walls and ceilings sealed; ceiling tiles in place
2018.correctiveAction: Seal the openings with an approved firestop and replace missing ceiling tiles.

2018.title: Decorations not flame-resistant
2018.description: Curtains and decorations flame-resistant, and covering no more than 10% of the walls
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the decorations, or show they are flame-resistant.

2018.title: Hazard placards missing
2018.description: NFPA 704 hazard placards on hazardous materials rooms and tanks
2018.correctiveAction: Post NFPA 704 placards on the room or tank.

2018.title: Gas cylinders not secured
2018.description: Compressed gas cylinders secured so they can't fall
2018.correctiveAction: Chain or strap the cylinders so they can't fall over.

2018.title: Flammable liquids stored improperly
2018.description: Flammable liquids in approved containers or cabinets, and within the allowed amounts
2018.correctiveAction: Move flammable liquids into approved containers or a flammable storage cabinet.

2018.title: LP-gas stored improperly
2018.description: LP-gas cylinders not stored indoors; exchange cages placed and protected
2018.correctiveAction: Move LP-gas cylinders outside to an approved location.

2018.title: No hazardous materials permit
2018.description: Hazardous materials permit current where over permit amounts
2018.correctiveAction: Apply for a hazardous materials operational permit.

2018.title: Safety data sheets missing
2018.description: Safety data sheets kept on site
2018.correctiveAction: Keep safety data sheets for every hazardous material on site.

2018.title: No evacuation plan
2018.description: Fire safety and evacuation plan on site where required, reviewed this year
2018.correctiveAction: Write a fire safety and evacuation plan and keep it on site.

2018.title: Evacuation drills not held
2018.description: Evacuation drills held as often as required, with records
2018.correctiveAction: Hold and record evacuation drills on schedule.

2018.title: Employees not trained
2018.description: Employees trained in evacuation and extinguisher use
2018.correctiveAction: Train employees in the evacuation plan and in using an extinguisher.

2018.title: Emergency radio system not tested
2018.description: Emergency radio coverage (BDA) system tested this year
2018.correctiveAction: Have the radio coverage system tested and send the report.

2018.title: Emergency generator not tested
2018.description: Emergency generator tested under load (NFPA 110)
2018.correctiveAction: Test the generator under load and keep the record.

2018.title: Solar labels or roof paths missing
2018.description: Solar panels labelled, with roof access paths kept clear
2018.correctiveAction: Install the required labels and keep the roof access paths clear.

2018.title: Battery storage system not approved
2018.description: Battery energy storage permitted, signed and separated
2018.correctiveAction: Apply for a permit and install the required signs and separation.

2018.title: Clean agent system not serviced
2018.description: Clean agent system serviced every 6 months
2018.correctiveAction: Have the clean agent system serviced.

2018.title: Construction site fire safety not kept
2018.description: Site safety plan on site, and a daily fire safety check kept
2018.correctiveAction: Keep the site safety plan and do the daily fire safety check.

2018.title: No water supply on a construction site
2018.description: Water supply for fire fighting in before combustible materials arrive
2018.correctiveAction: Have the hydrants or water supply working before combustible materials arrive.

2018.title: No fire access to the construction site
2018.description: All-weather fire access road to the site
2018.correctiveAction: Build and keep an all-weather access road for fire apparatus.

2018.title: Construction site extinguishers missing
2018.description: Extinguisher on each floor and near stairways, and in every shed or trailer
2018.correctiveAction: Put extinguishers on each floor, by each stairway and in each building on site.

2018.title: Tent put up without a permit
2018.description: Tent permit issued (tents over 400 sq ft)
2018.correctiveAction: Apply for a tent permit before the tent is used.

2018.title: No flame-resistance certificate for the tent
2018.description: Flame-resistance certificate for the tent fabric on site (NFPA 701)
2018.correctiveAction: Provide the tent's flame-resistance certificate.

2018.title: Tent too close to buildings or vehicles
2018.description: Tent at least 20 ft from property lines, buildings, other tents, parked cars and generators
2018.correctiveAction: Move the tent, or the vehicles, generators or structures it's too close to.

2018.title: Tent exits blocked or unmarked
2018.description: Tent exits marked, lit and unobstructed
2018.correctiveAction: Clear and mark the tent exits.

2018.title: Tent not anchored
2018.description: Tent anchored or ballasted against wind
2018.correctiveAction: Anchor or ballast the tent.

2018.title: Cooking or open flame inside a tent
2018.description: No cooking or open flame inside the tent; heaters approved and kept away
2018.correctiveAction: Move the cooking or open flame out of the tent.

2018.title: Tent no-smoking signs missing
2018.description: No-smoking signs in and around the tent
2018.correctiveAction: Post no-smoking signs in and around the tent.

2018.title: Food truck operating without a permit
2018.description: Mobile food vehicle permit current
2018.correctiveAction: Get a mobile food preparation vehicle permit.

2018.title: Food truck LP-gas unsafe
2018.description: LP-gas 200 lb or less in total, cylinders secured, LP-gas alarm working
2018.correctiveAction: Secure the cylinders, keep LP-gas to 200 lb or less, and fit a working LP-gas alarm.

2018.title: Food truck cooking not protected
2018.description: Cooking hood suppression serviced, and a Class K extinguisher on board
2018.correctiveAction: Have the hood suppression serviced and carry a Class K extinguisher.

2018.title: Fireworks stand permit not posted
2018.description: State fireworks retail permit and the local permit posted
2018.correctiveAction: Post the state retail permit and the local permit.

2018.title: No-smoking area not kept around fireworks
2018.description: No smoking within 50 ft, with signs posted
2018.correctiveAction: Post No Smoking signs and keep smoking 50 feet away.

2018.title: Fireworks stand extinguishers missing
2018.description: Water extinguishers (2-A) at the stand, as required
2018.correctiveAction: Put the required extinguishers at the stand.

2018.title: Fireworks stand too close to buildings or fuel
2018.description: Stand kept away from other buildings, fuel pumps and parking as required
2018.correctiveAction: Move the stand to the required distance.

2018.title: High grass and weeds
2018.description: Grass and weeds kept below the height the city allows
2018.correctiveAction: Mow the property and keep the grass and weeds below the allowed height.

2018.title: Trash and debris on the property
2018.description: No trash, debris or rubbish on the property
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the trash, debris and rubbish.

2018.title: Junked vehicle on the property
2018.description: No inoperable or unregistered vehicles stored outside
2018.correctiveAction: Remove the vehicle, repair it, or store it in a garage.

2018.title: Unsanitary property or standing water
2018.description: Yard clean and sanitary; no standing water
2018.correctiveAction: Clean up the property and drain the standing water.

2018.title: Exterior of the building in disrepair
2018.description: Roof, walls, windows and doors in good repair and weathertight
2018.correctiveAction: Repair the roof, walls, windows or doors.

2018.title: Vacant building open to entry
2018.description: Vacant building secured against entry
2018.correctiveAction: Board up or lock every opening.

2018.title: Fence or shed in disrepair
2018.description: Fences and sheds sound and in good repair
2018.correctiveAction: Repair or remove the fence or shed.

2018.title: Pool not kept or barrier missing
2018.description: Swimming pool kept clean, with its barrier in place
2018.correctiveAction: Clean the pool and repair the barrier.

2018.title: House number missing
2018.description: House number posted and readable from the street
2018.correctiveAction: Put up a house number that can be read from the street.

2018.title: Graffiti
2018.description: No graffiti on the property
2018.correctiveAction: Remove or paint over the graffiti.

2018.title: Rodent or pest harbourage
2018.description: No place for rats to nest; no pest infestation
2018.correctiveAction: Remove where pests can nest and treat for pests.

2018.title: Unsafe structure
2018.description: Structure safe, with no danger of collapse
2018.correctiveAction: Secure the structure, then repair or demolish it as ordered.

2018.title: Smoke alarms missing or not interconnected
2018.description: Smoke alarms in each bedroom, outside each sleeping area and on every level, interconnected
2018.correctiveAction: Install interconnected smoke alarms where required.

2018.title: Carbon monoxide alarms missing
2018.description: Carbon monoxide alarms outside sleeping areas where required
2018.correctiveAction: Install carbon monoxide alarms where required.

2018.title: Garage fire separation incomplete
2018.description: Garage separated from the house (½ in gypsum on the garage side)
2018.correctiveAction: Finish the gypsum separation between the garage and the house.

2018.title: Garage-to-house door not rated
2018.description: Door from the garage to the house solid wood or steel, or 20-minute rated
2018.correctiveAction: Install a solid, steel or 20-minute rated door.

2018.title: Bedroom escape window doesn't meet code
2018.description: Each bedroom has an escape window of the right size and sill height
2018.correctiveAction: Install an escape window of the required size and sill height.

2018.title: Stairs, handrails or guards not to code
2018.description: Stairs, handrails and guards in place and to code
2018.correctiveAction: Correct the stairs, handrails or guards.

2018.title: Address numbers missing
2018.description: Address numbers posted
2018.correctiveAction: Post address numbers that can be read from the street.

2018.title: Water heater relief valve not piped
2018.description: Water heater relief valve piped to a safe place and the heater secured
2018.correctiveAction: Pipe the relief valve discharge to an approved place.

2018.title: Grading doesn't drain away from the house
2018.description: Ground slopes away from the foundation
2018.correctiveAction: Regrade so water drains away from the foundation.

2018.title: No attic access
2018.description: Attic access opening provided
2018.correctiveAction: Provide an attic access opening.

2018.title: Trade finals not approved
2018.description: Electrical, plumbing and mechanical finals approved
2018.correctiveAction: Pass the electrical, plumbing and mechanical finals.

2021.title: Address numbers missing or not readable
2021.description: Address numbers can be read from the street: at least 4 in tall, ½ in stroke, contrasting colour
2021.correctiveAction: Put up address numbers at least 4 inches tall that can be read from the street.

2021.title: Fire lane blocked
2021.description: Fire lane clear: no parked cars, dumpsters or storage
2021.correctiveAction: Move everything parked or stored in the fire lane, and keep it clear at all times.

2021.title: Fire lane markings missing or faded
2021.description: Fire lane signs or red curb marked "No Parking – Fire Lane" and readable
2021.correctiveAction: Mark the fire lane with signs or painted curbs as the fire marshal approves.

2021.title: Fire lane too narrow or overhead clearance blocked
2021.description: Fire lane at least 20 ft wide with 13 ft 6 in clear overhead (trees trimmed)
2021.correctiveAction: Trim trees and remove anything that narrows the lane below 20 ft or lowers the clearance below 13 ft 6 in.

2021.title: Gate across the fire lane doesn't open for the fire department
2021.description: Security gate approved, and it opens for the fire department (Knox switch or strobe works)
2021.correctiveAction: Repair the gate's emergency opening device and have it tested.

2021.title: Key box missing
2021.description: Key box (Knox box) installed where required, in the approved spot
2021.correctiveAction: Install an approved key box where the fire marshal directs.

2021.title: Key box keys out of date
2021.description: Keys in the key box are current
2021.correctiveAction: Call the fire department to meet you and replace the keys in the key box.

2021.title: Fire hydrant blocked
2021.description: Fire hydrant visible, with 3 ft clear all around it
2021.correctiveAction: Clear everything within 3 feet of the fire hydrant.

2021.title: Private hydrants not tested
2021.description: Private hydrants and fire mains inspected and tested this year (NFPA 25)
2021.correctiveAction: Have a licensed company inspect and test the private hydrants and send the report.

2021.title: Fire department connection blocked
2021.description: Fire department connection reachable: 36 in wide, 36 in deep and 78 in high clear in front
2021.correctiveAction: Clear the space in front of the fire department connection.

2021.title: Fire department connection sign missing
2021.description: Fire department connection signed ("Automatic Sprinklers" or "Standpipe")
2021.correctiveAction: Put a sign at the connection saying what it supplies.

2021.title: Fire department connection damaged or uncapped
2021.description: Fire department connection caps in place, swivels turn, nothing inside
2021.correctiveAction: Replace missing caps and have the connection serviced.

2021.title: Equipment room doors not labelled
2021.description: Doors to the sprinkler riser, alarm panel and electrical rooms labelled
2021.correctiveAction: Label the doors to rooms holding fire protection or utility controls.

2021.title: Fire protection equipment blocked
2021.description: Fire protection equipment (riser, alarm panel, valves) reachable, nothing stored in front
2021.correctiveAction: Move the storage away from the fire protection equipment.

2021.title: Exit or exit path blocked
2021.description: Exits, the paths to them and the way out to the street clear and usable while open
2021.correctiveAction: Clear the exit path now, and keep it clear whenever the building is occupied.

2021.title: Corridor, aisle or stairway obstructed
2021.description: Corridors, aisles and stairs free of anything in the way
2021.correctiveAction: Remove what is blocking the corridor, aisle or stairway.

2021.title: Storage in an exit or stairway
2021.description: Nothing that burns stored in exits or stairways
2021.correctiveAction: Remove all storage from exits and stairways.

2021.title: Exit door needs a key or special effort to open
2021.description: Exit doors open from the inside without a key, tool or special effort
2021.correctiveAction: Change the lock so the door opens from inside without a key or special knowledge.

2021.title: Exit door chained, padlocked or barred
2021.description: No chains, padlocks, slide bolts or bars on exit doors while the building is occupied
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the chain, padlock, bolt or bar from the exit door now.

2021.title: Panic hardware missing or broken
2021.description: Panic hardware where required (assembly and schools with 50 or more people), and it works
2021.correctiveAction: Install or repair panic hardware on the exit doors.

2021.title: Exit door swings the wrong way
2021.description: Exit doors swing outward where 50 or more people use them
2021.correctiveAction: Re-hang the door to swing in the direction people leave.

2021.title: Exit sign missing
2021.description: Exit signs at every exit and wherever the way out isn't obvious
2021.correctiveAction: Install exit signs where required.

2021.title: Exit sign not lit
2021.description: Exit signs lit, and they stay lit on battery
2021.correctiveAction: Repair or replace the exit sign or its battery.

2021.title: Emergency lighting not working
2021.description: Emergency lights come on when tested
2021.correctiveAction: Repair or replace the emergency lights or their batteries.

2021.title: Emergency lighting tests not recorded
2021.description: Emergency lights tested monthly (30 sec) and yearly (90 min), with records
2021.correctiveAction: Test the emergency lights monthly and yearly, and keep a written record.

2021.title: Occupant load sign not posted
2021.description: Occupant load sign posted (assembly rooms)
2021.correctiveAction: Post the approved occupant load sign near the main exit.

2021.title: Room overcrowded
2021.description: No more people inside than the posted occupant load
2021.correctiveAction: Reduce the number of people to the posted occupant load now.

2021.title: Exit door hidden or decorated
2021.description: No mirrors, hangings or decorations on or hiding exit doors
2021.correctiveAction: Remove mirrors, curtains or decorations that hide the exit door.

2021.title: Stairway signs missing
2021.description: Stairway floor-number signs in place
2021.correctiveAction: Put up the stairway identification signs on each floor.

2021.title: Escape window blocked or barred
2021.description: Bedroom escape windows open, and any security bars release from inside
2021.correctiveAction: Make the window open fully, or fit bars that release from inside without a key.

2021.title: Fire extinguisher missing
2021.description: Fire extinguishers provided where required
2021.correctiveAction: Install a fire extinguisher of the right type where required.

2021.title: Fire extinguisher service out of date
2021.description: Yearly service tag current, from a company licensed by the State Fire Marshal
2021.correctiveAction: Have the extinguisher serviced by a company licensed by the State Fire Marshal's Office.

2021.title: Monthly extinguisher checks not done
2021.description: Monthly checks initialled on the tag or a log
2021.correctiveAction: Check each extinguisher monthly and initial the tag.

2021.title: Not enough fire extinguishers
2021.description: Right type and size, and no more than 75 ft to reach one
2021.correctiveAction: Add extinguishers so none is more than 75 feet away.

2021.title: Fire extinguisher not mounted
2021.description: Mounted on a hanger or bracket, or in a cabinet
2021.correctiveAction: Mount the extinguisher on a hanger or bracket.

2021.title: Fire extinguisher at the wrong height
2021.description: Top no higher than 5 ft (3½ ft if over 40 lb), bottom at least 4 in off the floor
2021.correctiveAction: Re-hang the extinguisher at the right height.

2021.title: Fire extinguisher hidden or blocked
2021.description: Visible and unobstructed on the normal way through (signed if out of sight)
2021.correctiveAction: Move what's blocking the extinguisher, or put up a sign showing where it is.

2021.title: Kitchen (Class K) extinguisher missing
2021.description: Class K extinguisher near commercial fryers and cooking
2021.correctiveAction: Install a Class K extinguisher within 30 feet of the cooking appliances.

2021.title: Fire extinguisher discharged or damaged
2021.description: Gauge in the green, pin and seal in place, no damage
2021.correctiveAction: Have the extinguisher recharged or replaced.

2021.title: Extinguisher hydrostatic test out of date
2021.description: Hydrostatic test and 6-year internal exam current
2021.correctiveAction: Have the extinguisher tested or replaced.

2021.title: Fire alarm panel in trouble
2021.description: Alarm panel normal: no trouble, supervisory or alarm lights
2021.correctiveAction: Have a licensed alarm company find and fix the trouble condition.

2021.title: Fire alarm not tested this year
2021.description: Yearly fire alarm inspection and test report on file
2021.correctiveAction: Have a licensed alarm company inspect and test the system and send the report.

2021.title: Fire alarm not monitored
2021.description: Alarm monitoring active
2021.correctiveAction: Restore monitoring by an approved central station and tell the fire department.

2021.title: Fire alarm device covered or damaged
2021.description: Pull stations, detectors and horn/strobes uncovered, undamaged and unobstructed
2021.correctiveAction: Uncover, clear or repair the fire alarm devices.

2021.title: Smoke alarm missing or not working
2021.description: Smoke alarms in bedrooms and hallways work and are less than 10 years old
2021.correctiveAction: Install working smoke alarms in every bedroom and the hallway outside.

2021.title: Carbon monoxide alarm missing
2021.description: Carbon monoxide alarms where there are fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage
2021.correctiveAction: Install carbon monoxide alarms where required.

2021.title: Sprinkler control valve closed or unsecured
2021.description: Sprinkler system in service; control valves open and locked, sealed or supervised
2021.correctiveAction: Open and secure the valve and tell the fire department; keep a fire watch until it's restored.

2021.title: Sprinkler system not inspected this year
2021.description: Yearly sprinkler inspection and test report on file
2021.correctiveAction: Have a licensed sprinkler company inspect and test the system and send the report.

2021.title: Sprinkler gauges out of date or reading low
2021.description: Gauges show normal pressure and are less than 5 years old
2021.correctiveAction: Have the gauges replaced or calibrated and the pressure checked.

2021.title: Sprinkler heads damaged, painted or loaded
2021.description: Sprinkler heads not painted, corroded, loaded with dust or grease, or damaged
2021.correctiveAction: Have the affected sprinkler heads replaced by a licensed company.

2021.title: Storage too close to sprinkler heads
2021.description: Storage at least 18 in below sprinkler heads
2021.correctiveAction: Lower the storage so it is at least 18 inches below the sprinkler heads.

2021.title: Spare sprinkler heads missing
2021.description: Spare-head cabinet stocked (at least 6 of each type) with the wrench
2021.correctiveAction: Stock the spare-head cabinet with heads of each type and the wrench.

2021.title: Sprinkler riser room blocked or used for storage
2021.description: Riser room reachable, kept above 40°F, nothing stored in it
2021.correctiveAction: Clear the riser room and keep it heated.

2021.title: Five-year sprinkler pipe inspection not done
2021.description: Five-year internal pipe inspection done
2021.correctiveAction: Have the internal obstruction investigation done and send the report.

2021.title: Fire pump tests not done
2021.description: Fire pump run weekly or monthly and flow-tested yearly, with records
2021.correctiveAction: Run and test the fire pump on schedule and keep the records.

2021.title: Standpipe not maintained
2021.description: Standpipe hose valves capped and reachable; 5-year flow test done
2021.correctiveAction: Cap the hose valves and have the standpipe flow-tested.

2021.title: Backflow preventer not tested
2021.description: Fire line backflow preventer tested this year
2021.correctiveAction: Have the backflow preventer tested by a licensed tester.

2021.title: System out of service without notice or fire watch
2021.description: Any system out of service is tagged, the fire department told, and a fire watch posted
2021.correctiveAction: Tell the fire department and post a fire watch until the system is back in service.

2021.title: Fire protection equipment tampered with
2021.description: No fire protection equipment removed or tampered with
2021.correctiveAction: Restore the equipment and have it checked by a licensed company.

2021.title: Fire protection records not kept
2021.description: Inspection, test and maintenance records kept on site
2021.correctiveAction: Keep the inspection, test and maintenance reports on site.

2021.title: Cooking appliance not protected by the hood system
2021.description: Hood suppression covers every grease-producing appliance
2021.correctiveAction: Move the appliance under the hood, or have the suppression system extended.

2021.title: Hood suppression system not serviced
2021.description: Hood suppression serviced every 6 months (tag or report)
2021.correctiveAction: Have a licensed company service the hood suppression system.

2021.title: Fusible links out of date
2021.description: Fusible links replaced and dated on schedule
2021.correctiveAction: Have the fusible links replaced.

2021.title: Hood system pull station blocked or missing
2021.description: Manual pull station reachable on the way out
2021.correctiveAction: Clear the manual pull station, or have one installed on the way out.

2021.title: Appliances don't shut off with the hood system
2021.description: Fuel or power to the appliances shuts off when the system goes off
2021.correctiveAction: Have the fuel or power shutoff repaired and tested.

2021.title: Hood and duct need cleaning
2021.description: Hood and duct cleaned on schedule (sticker or certificate)
2021.correctiveAction: Have the hood and exhaust duct cleaned by a qualified company and post the certificate.

2021.title: Grease built up on the hood or filters
2021.description: Filters in place; no grease built up on the hood or filters
2021.correctiveAction: Clean the hood and filters and replace any missing filters.

2021.title: Cooking oil stored improperly
2021.description: Cooking oil kept in approved containers or tanks
2021.correctiveAction: Store cooking oil in approved containers or tanks.

2021.title: Extension cord used as permanent wiring
2021.description: Extension cords not used in place of permanent wiring, or run through walls, doors or under rugs
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the extension cords and have permanent outlets installed where needed.

2021.title: Power strips misused
2021.description: Power strips listed, with a breaker, plugged into the wall, not plugged into each other
2021.correctiveAction: Plug each power strip straight into a wall outlet and remove strips plugged into strips.

2021.title: Electrical panel blocked
2021.description: 30 in wide, 36 in deep and 78 in high clear in front of electrical panels
2021.correctiveAction: Clear the space in front of the electrical panel.

2021.title: Exposed wiring or missing cover
2021.description: Covers on junction boxes, outlets, switches and panels; no open splices
2021.correctiveAction: Install covers, and have exposed wiring repaired by a licensed electrician.

2021.title: Temporary wiring in use too long
2021.description: Temporary wiring used no more than 90 days
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the temporary wiring or have permanent wiring installed.

2021.title: Space heater used unsafely
2021.description: Space heaters listed, plugged straight into the wall, 3 ft from anything that burns
2021.correctiveAction: Plug the heater straight into the wall and keep it 3 feet from anything that can burn.

2021.title: Unvented fuel-burning heater in use
2021.description: No unvented fuel-burning portable heaters
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the unvented heater.

2021.title: Fuel-burning appliance installed or vented improperly
2021.description: Fuel-burning appliances installed and vented to code
2021.correctiveAction: Have the appliance installed and vented by a licensed contractor.

2021.title: Combustible waste allowed to build up
2021.description: No piled-up trash or combustible waste
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the trash and combustible waste and keep it from building up.

2021.title: Storage unsafe or too close to heat
2021.description: Storage orderly, stable and away from heaters and lights
2021.correctiveAction: Restack the storage and keep it away from heaters and lights.

2021.title: Storage too close to the ceiling
2021.description: Storage at least 24 in below the ceiling where there are no sprinklers
2021.correctiveAction: Lower the storage to at least 24 inches below the ceiling.

2021.title: Storage in an equipment room
2021.description: Nothing stored in boiler, mechanical, electrical or elevator rooms
2021.correctiveAction: Remove all storage from the equipment room.

2021.title: Storage in a concealed space
2021.description: Nothing stored in attics, under floors or in other hidden spaces
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the storage from the attic or concealed space.

2021.title: Oily rags not in a metal can
2021.description: Oily rags kept in listed metal cans with lids
2021.correctiveAction: Keep oily rags in a listed metal can with a tight lid.

2021.title: Dumpster too close to the building
2021.description: Dumpsters (1 cubic yard or larger) kept 5 ft from walls, openings and eaves that burn
2021.correctiveAction: Move the dumpster at least 5 feet from the building.

2021.title: Outside storage too close to the building
2021.description: Outside storage kept away from openings, eaves and property lines
2021.correctiveAction: Move the outside storage away from the building and property lines.

2021.title: Vacant building open or unprotected
2021.description: Vacant building secured, and its fire protection kept working
2021.correctiveAction: Secure every opening and keep the fire protection systems working.

2021.title: Grill used too close to the building
2021.description: Grills not on combustible balconies or within 10 ft of combustible construction
2021.correctiveAction: Use grills at least 10 feet from the building and off combustible balconies.

2021.title: No-smoking signs missing
2021.description: "No Smoking" signs where required; approved ash cans provided
2021.correctiveAction: Post no-smoking signs where required.

2021.title: Hot work without a fire watch
2021.description: Hot work has a fire watch during and 30 min after, and an extinguisher within 30 ft
2021.correctiveAction: Stop the hot work until a fire watch and an extinguisher are in place.

2021.title: Fire door propped open or not closing
2021.description: Fire doors close and latch by themselves, and aren't wedged or blocked open
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the wedge or block and repair the closer so the door closes and latches.

2021.title: Fire doors not inspected this year
2021.description: Fire doors inspected and tested this year (NFPA 80 record)
2021.correctiveAction: Have the fire doors inspected and keep the record.

2021.title: Opening in a fire-rated wall or ceiling
2021.description: Holes in fire-rated walls and ceilings sealed; ceiling tiles in place
2021.correctiveAction: Seal the openings with an approved firestop and replace missing ceiling tiles.

2021.title: Decorations not flame-resistant
2021.description: Curtains and decorations flame-resistant, and covering no more than 10% of the walls
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the decorations, or show they are flame-resistant.

2021.title: Hazard placards missing
2021.description: NFPA 704 hazard placards on hazardous materials rooms and tanks
2021.correctiveAction: Post NFPA 704 placards on the room or tank.

2021.title: Gas cylinders not secured
2021.description: Compressed gas cylinders secured so they can't fall
2021.correctiveAction: Chain or strap the cylinders so they can't fall over.

2021.title: Flammable liquids stored improperly
2021.description: Flammable liquids in approved containers or cabinets, and within the allowed amounts
2021.correctiveAction: Move flammable liquids into approved containers or a flammable storage cabinet.

2021.title: LP-gas stored improperly
2021.description: LP-gas cylinders not stored indoors; exchange cages placed and protected
2021.correctiveAction: Move LP-gas cylinders outside to an approved location.

2021.title: No hazardous materials permit
2021.description: Hazardous materials permit current where over permit amounts
2021.correctiveAction: Apply for a hazardous materials operational permit.

2021.title: Safety data sheets missing
2021.description: Safety data sheets kept on site
2021.correctiveAction: Keep safety data sheets for every hazardous material on site.

2021.title: No evacuation plan
2021.description: Fire safety and evacuation plan on site where required, reviewed this year
2021.correctiveAction: Write a fire safety and evacuation plan and keep it on site.

2021.title: Evacuation drills not held
2021.description: Evacuation drills held as often as required, with records
2021.correctiveAction: Hold and record evacuation drills on schedule.

2021.title: Employees not trained
2021.description: Employees trained in evacuation and extinguisher use
2021.correctiveAction: Train employees in the evacuation plan and in using an extinguisher.

2021.title: Emergency radio system not tested
2021.description: Emergency radio coverage (BDA) system tested this year
2021.correctiveAction: Have the radio coverage system tested and send the report.

2021.title: Emergency generator not tested
2021.description: Emergency generator tested under load (NFPA 110)
2021.correctiveAction: Test the generator under load and keep the record.

2021.title: Solar labels or roof paths missing
2021.description: Solar panels labelled, with roof access paths kept clear
2021.correctiveAction: Install the required labels and keep the roof access paths clear.

2021.title: Battery storage system not approved
2021.description: Battery energy storage permitted, signed and separated
2021.correctiveAction: Apply for a permit and install the required signs and separation.

2021.title: Clean agent system not serviced
2021.description: Clean agent system serviced every 6 months
2021.correctiveAction: Have the clean agent system serviced.

2021.title: Construction site fire safety not kept
2021.description: Site safety plan on site, and a daily fire safety check kept
2021.correctiveAction: Keep the site safety plan and do the daily fire safety check.

2021.title: No water supply on a construction site
2021.description: Water supply for fire fighting in before combustible materials arrive
2021.correctiveAction: Have the hydrants or water supply working before combustible materials arrive.

2021.title: No fire access to the construction site
2021.description: All-weather fire access road to the site
2021.correctiveAction: Build and keep an all-weather access road for fire apparatus.

2021.title: Construction site extinguishers missing
2021.description: Extinguisher on each floor and near stairways, and in every shed or trailer
2021.correctiveAction: Put extinguishers on each floor, by each stairway and in each building on site.

2021.title: Tent put up without a permit
2021.description: Tent permit issued (tents over 400 sq ft)
2021.correctiveAction: Apply for a tent permit before the tent is used.

2021.title: No flame-resistance certificate for the tent
2021.description: Flame-resistance certificate for the tent fabric on site (NFPA 701)
2021.correctiveAction: Provide the tent's flame-resistance certificate.

2021.title: Tent too close to buildings or vehicles
2021.description: Tent at least 20 ft from property lines, buildings, other tents, parked cars and generators
2021.correctiveAction: Move the tent, or the vehicles, generators or structures it's too close to.

2021.title: Tent exits blocked or unmarked
2021.description: Tent exits marked, lit and unobstructed
2021.correctiveAction: Clear and mark the tent exits.

2021.title: Tent not anchored
2021.description: Tent anchored or ballasted against wind
2021.correctiveAction: Anchor or ballast the tent.

2021.title: Cooking or open flame inside a tent
2021.description: No cooking or open flame inside the tent; heaters approved and kept away
2021.correctiveAction: Move the cooking or open flame out of the tent.

2021.title: Tent no-smoking signs missing
2021.description: No-smoking signs in and around the tent
2021.correctiveAction: Post no-smoking signs in and around the tent.

2021.title: Food truck operating without a permit
2021.description: Mobile food vehicle permit current
2021.correctiveAction: Get a mobile food preparation vehicle permit.

2021.title: Food truck LP-gas unsafe
2021.description: LP-gas 200 lb or less in total, cylinders secured, LP-gas alarm working
2021.correctiveAction: Secure the cylinders, keep LP-gas to 200 lb or less, and fit a working LP-gas alarm.

2021.title: Food truck cooking not protected
2021.description: Cooking hood suppression serviced, and a Class K extinguisher on board
2021.correctiveAction: Have the hood suppression serviced and carry a Class K extinguisher.

2021.title: Fireworks stand permit not posted
2021.description: State fireworks retail permit and the local permit posted
2021.correctiveAction: Post the state retail permit and the local permit.

2021.title: No-smoking area not kept around fireworks
2021.description: No smoking within 50 ft, with signs posted
2021.correctiveAction: Post No Smoking signs and keep smoking 50 feet away.

2021.title: Fireworks stand extinguishers missing
2021.description: Water extinguishers (2-A) at the stand, as required
2021.correctiveAction: Put the required extinguishers at the stand.

2021.title: Fireworks stand too close to buildings or fuel
2021.description: Stand kept away from other buildings, fuel pumps and parking as required
2021.correctiveAction: Move the stand to the required distance.

2021.title: High grass and weeds
2021.description: Grass and weeds kept below the height the city allows
2021.correctiveAction: Mow the property and keep the grass and weeds below the allowed height.

2021.title: Trash and debris on the property
2021.description: No trash, debris or rubbish on the property
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the trash, debris and rubbish.

2021.title: Junked vehicle on the property
2021.description: No inoperable or unregistered vehicles stored outside
2021.correctiveAction: Remove the vehicle, repair it, or store it in a garage.

2021.title: Unsanitary property or standing water
2021.description: Yard clean and sanitary; no standing water
2021.correctiveAction: Clean up the property and drain the standing water.

2021.title: Exterior of the building in disrepair
2021.description: Roof, walls, windows and doors in good repair and weathertight
2021.correctiveAction: Repair the roof, walls, windows or doors.

2021.title: Vacant building open to entry
2021.description: Vacant building secured against entry
2021.correctiveAction: Board up or lock every opening.

2021.title: Fence or shed in disrepair
2021.description: Fences and sheds sound and in good repair
2021.correctiveAction: Repair or remove the fence or shed.

2021.title: Pool not kept or barrier missing
2021.description: Swimming pool kept clean, with its barrier in place
2021.correctiveAction: Clean the pool and repair the barrier.

2021.title: House number missing
2021.description: House number posted and readable from the street
2021.correctiveAction: Put up a house number that can be read from the street.

2021.title: Graffiti
2021.description: No graffiti on the property
2021.correctiveAction: Remove or paint over the graffiti.

2021.title: Rodent or pest harbourage
2021.description: No place for rats to nest; no pest infestation
2021.correctiveAction: Remove where pests can nest and treat for pests.

2021.title: Unsafe structure
2021.description: Structure safe, with no danger of collapse
2021.correctiveAction: Secure the structure, then repair or demolish it as ordered.

2021.title: Smoke alarms missing or not interconnected
2021.description: Smoke alarms in each bedroom, outside each sleeping area and on every level, interconnected
2021.correctiveAction: Install interconnected smoke alarms where required.

2021.title: Carbon monoxide alarms missing
2021.description: Carbon monoxide alarms outside sleeping areas where required
2021.correctiveAction: Install carbon monoxide alarms where required.

2021.title: Garage fire separation incomplete
2021.description: Garage separated from the house (½ in gypsum on the garage side)
2021.correctiveAction: Finish the gypsum separation between the garage and the house.

2021.title: Garage-to-house door not rated
2021.description: Door from the garage to the house solid wood or steel, or 20-minute rated
2021.correctiveAction: Install a solid, steel or 20-minute rated door.

2021.title: Bedroom escape window doesn't meet code
2021.description: Each bedroom has an escape window of the right size and sill height
2021.correctiveAction: Install an escape window of the required size and sill height.

2021.title: Stairs, handrails or guards not to code
2021.description: Stairs, handrails and guards in place and to code
2021.correctiveAction: Correct the stairs, handrails or guards.

2021.title: Address numbers missing
2021.description: Address numbers posted
2021.correctiveAction: Post address numbers that can be read from the street.

2021.title: Water heater relief valve not piped
2021.description: Water heater relief valve piped to a safe place and the heater secured
2021.correctiveAction: Pipe the relief valve discharge to an approved place.

2021.title: Grading doesn't drain away from the house
2021.description: Ground slopes away from the foundation
2021.correctiveAction: Regrade so water drains away from the foundation.

2021.title: No attic access
2021.description: Attic access opening provided
2021.correctiveAction: Provide an attic access opening.

2021.title: Trade finals not approved
2021.description: Electrical, plumbing and mechanical finals approved
2021.correctiveAction: Pass the electrical, plumbing and mechanical finals.

2018.name: Fire inspection: full
2018.description: Every area of a fire inspection. Mark what doesn't apply N/A.

items.text: Address numbers can be read from the street: at least 4 in tall, ½ in stroke, contrasting colour
Fire lane clear: no parked cars, dumpsters or storage
Fire lane signs or red curb marked "No Parking – Fire Lane" and readable
Fire lane at least 20 ft wide with 13 ft 6 in clear overhead (trees trimmed)
Security gate approved, and it opens for the fire department (Knox switch or strobe works)
Key box (Knox box) installed where required, in the approved spot
Keys in the key box are current
Fire hydrant visible, with 3 ft clear all around it
Private hydrants and fire mains inspected and tested this year (NFPA 25)
Fire department connection reachable: 36 in wide, 36 in deep and 78 in high clear in front
Fire department connection signed ("Automatic Sprinklers" or "Standpipe")
Fire department connection caps in place, swivels turn, nothing inside
Doors to the sprinkler riser, alarm panel and electrical rooms labelled
Fire protection equipment (riser, alarm panel, valves) reachable, nothing stored in front
Exits, the paths to them and the way out to the street clear and usable while open
Corridors, aisles and stairs free of anything in the way
Nothing that burns stored in exits or stairways
Exit doors open from the inside without a key, tool or special effort
No chains, padlocks, slide bolts or bars on exit doors while the building is occupied
Panic hardware where required (assembly and schools with 50 or more people), and it works
Exit doors swing outward where 50 or more people use them
Exit signs at every exit and wherever the way out isn't obvious
Exit signs lit, and they stay lit on battery
Emergency lights come on when tested
Emergency lights tested monthly (30 sec) and yearly (90 min), with records
Occupant load sign posted (assembly rooms)
No more people inside than the posted occupant load
No mirrors, hangings or decorations on or hiding exit doors
Stairway floor-number signs in place
Bedroom escape windows open, and any security bars release from inside
Fire extinguishers provided where required
Yearly service tag current, from a company licensed by the State Fire Marshal
Monthly checks initialled on the tag or a log
Right type and size, and no more than 75 ft to reach one
